title: Finite Koszul structural facts for principal opens
statement: Intermediate structural conjunction: the triangle, perfectness, and augmentation compatibility clauses of lem-sc-affine-perfect-open-represent-cohomology.

proof.text: Obtain a module-level cone isomorphism compatible with the structure inclusion from [lem-sc-koszul-open-cone-comparison]. Transport it by the additive termwise tilde functor, using Mathlib mappingCone.mapHomologicalComplexIso and map_inr, then localize by DerivedCategory.Q. The standard mapping-cone triangle is distinguished by DerivedCategory.mappingCone_triangle_distinguished. Set delta to the inverse localized cone isomorphism followed by its third arrow; Triangle.isoMk with identities on the first two objects proves that the required triangle is isomorphic to it.

For exponent e+1, apply the perfectness clause of [lem-sc-affine-perfect-koszul-principal-unit]. Its shiftedKoszulComplex and termwise tilde object are definitionally equal to koszulOpenObject. Positivity follows from 1<=e+1.

Prove the degree-zero boundary is the linear form Finsupp.linearCombination on wedge^1, composed with exteriorPower.oneEquiv: check on exteriorPower.ιMulti and use CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_ι. The power comparison multiplies generator i by f_i^(b-a). exteriorPower.oneEquiv_naturality reduces augmentation compatibility to f_i^(b-a)*f_i^(a+1)=f_i^(b+1), using a<=b. ChainComplex.toSingle0Equiv reduces equality of augmentation maps to that component. Finally extension, termwise tilde, and DerivedCategory.Q preserve composition, giving the derived compatibility clause.

proof_origin.place: Section 36.9 (Tag 08CX), opening construction of I and its Koszul triangle; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08CX because the local TeX source is absent. Lean reduction by H3: module cone comparison, existing perfectness, and proved augmentation compatibility.
